title: Tenant replay harness and adaptive per-tenant cooldown for hosted API escalations
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description:
Summary:
A pattern of tenant-driven 5xx/timeouts coupled with aggressive client retries has repeatedly led to customer escalations and partial cluster degradation. Existing mitigations (tenant quarantine, static backoffs) are effective but hard to validate without a reproducible way to simulate real tenant traffic and retry behavior across Hosted/Dedicated/Private environments.

Goal:
1) Build a lightweight tenant-replay harness that can replay anonymized tenant traces (prefixes, request sizes, streaming vs non-streaming) against staging and dedicated clusters to reproduce escalations deterministically.
2) Ship an adaptive per-tenant cooldown controller: a policy that enforces a temporary, measurable cooldown on high-error tenants, exposes the cooldown state via telemetry, and automatically relaxes when KPIs recover.

Scope of work:
- Trace ingestion pipeline to sanitize and export tenant traces to replay format (privacy-preserving)
- Replay harness service (k8s job + CLI) capable of running at various concurrency profiles and SDK retry patterns (exponential jittered, constant, client-side hedging scenarios)
- Short-lived ephemeral deployments to run replays against Dedicated and Private test clusters (with tenant-mapping to avoid cross-tenant leakage)
- Implement cooldown controller in the admission/proxy layer that records cooldown windows, reasons, and metrics (requests blocked, degraded responses, cooldown_duration)
- Observability: dashboard panels for replay runs, cooldown state per-tenant, and a CI check that validates PRs touching retries/backoff logic by running a short replay battery

Non-goals:
- Permanent tenant billing changes or quota enforcement beyond temporary cooldown (this is an operational safety shim, not a billing control)
- Replacing existing tenant quarantines entirely; cooldown can be an intermediate automatic step before manual quarantine
acceptance_criteria:
1) Replay harness can consume sanitized tenant traces and reproduce a known escalation within +/- 15% of observed error-rate in staging.
2) Cooldown controller can be toggled (on/off) per-cluster via config and applied to a tenant id, recording telemetry visible in the Console.
3) Automated CI check runs a minimal replay (5 minutes) on PRs that modify retry/backoff code paths and fails the PR if regressions in headroom or error amplification are detected.
4) Internal runbook updated with steps to run a replay and to lift/extend cooldowns; runbook link included in ticket.
5) No PII persists in the replay artifact store; privacy audit pass completed by Security reviewers.
